text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, this is a tough choice. We've already 
strolled around town and went to the 
amusement park, so...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Perhaps we should switch 
things up next time and go somewhere more 
peaceful...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about the sea? Look at 
this blue ocean and white sandy beach! 
Doesn't it just make you want to start 
sprinting!?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so pretty...! The water is so clear, 
too. The shadow of the boat is reflecting 
on the seabed...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping I could go with the two of 
you. We can play to our hearts' content at 
the beach, and besides...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, the mom who raised me 
told me, 'Your other mom is in the sea.' I 
still go visit there from time to time, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to introduce you both to my other 
mom. To tell her, "Look how close I am 
with such cute juniors!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much. I'm so happy. 
To think I could join Spe-san at such a 
special place.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I can't wait to play! And after 
that, we can chat while watching the sun 
set over the ocean... It feels so full of 
youthful romance, how wonderful ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next destination is the beach! We 
can swim a lot, play in the sand, and then 
get shaved ice at a beach hut!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what shave ice flavor to get~. 
Strawberry, melon, lemon... Ordering 
different flavors and sharing sounds fun 
too♪ I wonder if they have yakisoba and 
grilled squid?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'm sure there are. I'll look into 
transportation and places to eat.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A trip to the sea with the three of us is 
sure to be an unforgettable memory♪
